note: The points as lists, as the corpus writes some: the same part as tuples. A 4 x 6 x 8 box centred on the origin, a hole of diameter 1 through it at each centre. Each cylinder (r = 1/2) runs the box's extent `length` along `axis`: it removes pi r^2 length, takes two discs from the faces and adds its wall, 2 pi r length. The holes are apart and inside the face, so the part has 6 planes and one cylinder per hole, genus n. Each hole's centroid is its centre with the axis coordinate 0, so the part's is -(pi r^2 length) sum(centres) / V.
